import pandas as pd, glob, os
all=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; all.append(d)
x=pd.concat(all,ignore_index=True)
print(x.shape, x.columns.tolist())
print(x.groupby('carrier').size())
for c,g in x.groupby('carrier'):
 idcol='flight_id'; print(c,'dup ids',g[idcol].duplicated().sum(),'rows',len(g),'unique',g[idcol].nunique())
print(x[['origin','dest']].head())
# normalize routes, count raw and dedup
x['route']=x.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
print('RAW\n',x.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
y=x.drop_duplicates('flight_id')
print('DEDUP\n',y.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
print('date cols', [c for c in x.columns if 'date' in c])

air=pd.read_csv('airports.csv'); print(air.to_string(index=False))
asd=x[x.carrier=='AS'].copy(); print(asd[['flight_id','date_utc','origin','sched_dep_utc']].query("date_utc=='2025-01-01' or date_utc=='2025-02-28'").to_string(index=False))
# convert AS scheduled UTC to local based origin offset; show outside Jan-Feb
m=asd.merge(air[['airport','utc_offset_hours']],left_on='origin',right_on='airport',how='left')
asd['localdt']=pd.to_datetime(asd['date_utc']+' '+asd['sched_dep_utc'],format='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') + pd.to_timedelta(m['utc_offset_hours'].values,unit='h')
print(asd[['flight_id','date_utc','origin','sched_dep_utc','localdt']].sort_values('localdt').head(5).to_string(index=False)); print(asd.sort_values('localdt').tail(5)[['flight_id','date_utc','origin','sched_dep_utc','localdt']].to_string(index=False))
print('outside',asd[~asd.localdt.dt.date.astype(str).str[:7].isin(['2025-01','2025-02'])].to_string(index=False))
